speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">A buzzing keeps going off in the distant haze of consciousness.</color>

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">You look over. A new job notification is flashing on your computer. HPD. Work.</color>

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">Yawning, you play the notification from your boss.</color>

speaker: Boss
text: M. Want some overtime work?

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">It wasn't really a question. You'd made it explicitly clear last week that you needed the cash.</color>

speaker: Boss
text: Allison Corp HQ needs some extra rooftop coverage.

speaker: Boss
text: Thomasin's pulled out, so it'll just be you. Not that we're expecting any noise. Should be a quiet night.

speaker: Boss
text: You'll be fine. Think of the holiday rates. Easy money.

speaker: Boss
text: Come on M, don't give me that look. <color="#999999">It's a one way message.</color>

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">You click the accept job button. The screen doesn't actually have any other option...</color>

speaker: Mouse PD
text: It was the night before christmas, and all through the city, not a creature was stirring, except for...

speaker: Mouse PD
text: Hold it, who are you?

speaker: unknown
text: Does it matter? Nap time.

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">Static swells in fills your vision and the world suddenly fades to a silent grey...</color>

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">Two notification alarms in one night… You come too on the rooftop. The alarm is actually the siren of a police copter hovering overhead.</color>

speaker: Boss
text: First Thomasin, and now you, sleeping on the job, M? Convenient…

speaker: Boss
text: While you were having your little nap, thieves entered the Allison facility and stole 21 TB of ghost data during a transfer.

speaker: Mouse PD
text: I had nothing to do with it…

speaker: Boss
text: And yet, the security tapes clearly show you talking with the thief moments prior.

speaker: Boss
text: You didn't put up even a moment's resistance. It stands to obvious reason that you were in cohoots with the team

speaker: Mouse PD
text: That doesn't make sense.

speaker: Boss
text: I hope they paid well, because you are under arrest. Your employment at HPD has been terminated

speaker: Mouse PD
text: What, I…

speaker: Boss
text: All property of the HPD, including your HPD provided employee unit and all complementary property within revert immediately to the HPD's ownership

speaker: Boss
text: And as of 30 seconds ago, your social rights have reverted to class D

speaker: Boss
text: Now, if you'd be kind enough to stay still and hold out your hands, these fine security officers need to cuff you.

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#999999">You know, M. There is another option. You could always...</color>

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Take a seat, friend. You look down on your luck.

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Another victim of the corp hegemony?

speaker: Mouse
text: <color="#999999">You nod.</color>

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Who do you work for?

speaker: Mouse
text: Did. <color="#999999">You flash your useless HPD ID.</color>

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Of course. Hungry?

speaker: Mouse
text: <color="#999999">You nod again</color>

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Toppings?

speaker: Mouse
text: <color="#999999">You shrug.</color>

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: The works then. On the house.

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: A good evening starts with a good hotdog friend.

speaker: Anarchist
text: Class C Security, huh. I'd be careful flashing that card around here. I overheard your predicament.

speaker: Anarchist
text: What did you do? Penetration? Diving? Exploiting? Wait, don't tell me. You have the eyes of a solo.

speaker: Anarchist
text: I have work for somebody like you. If you're interested, of course... Simple slurp and dash. Walk in, fiddle some slots, walk out.

speaker: Anarchist
text: Easy work.

speaker: Mouse
text: <color="#999999">At this point, what do you have to lose? You know.</color>

speaker: Anarchist
text: <color="#999999">He slides a note and a memory stick to you across the counter. The note is the name of a corp.</color>

speaker: Anarchist
text: Speak to Salie when you're ready. She can get you in the front door. The rest will be on you.

speaker: Anarchist
text: Take everything you can get your hands on. The more, the happier I'll be. Meet me back here once you're done.

speaker: Mouse
text: Security?

speaker: Anarchist
text: <color="#999999">He shrugs.</color>Do what you need to do.
